Hello.
Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures was released today, March 13th, 2025! Please enjoy the adventures of apprentice witch Lily to your heart's content. 

If you find any bugs in the game, please let us know on the message board. Also, if you like the game, please send us your thoughts in a review!

Let's dive into the world of magic and adventure with Witchroid Vania!

notes.title: Launch Date Confirmed!

notes.title: Build review completed: Final adjustments before release!
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/5f4f9125ade1a3dbd20bc7b09a28b90eff61bdbe.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to announce that the build review for “[b]Witchroid Vania[/b]” has been submitted and passed, and that preparations for release are now complete! We are currently continuing to make final adjustments, such as balancing and bug fixing, in preparation for release, and we are aiming to release the game in March, once the console version is complete.

We would be grateful if you could give us a little more time to improve the game. And, We will let you know as soon as the release date is confirmed, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: Dev News: January 2025
notes.notes:
Hello.

On the 27th of last month, we released the latest video update, “Waku Waku Games News December 2024”, which gives you the latest information on Waku Waku Games. In this video, we give you the latest information on “Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures”, so please take a look if you're interested. It's a little long, at about 30 minutes.

[previewyoutube=o6he1tLjyPE;full][/previewyoutube]
As we mention in the video, the game is already in the final adjustment stage.
The main balance adjustments have been completed, and we are now starting to work on the Chinese-support.
We hope to be able to introduce “Witchroid Vania” to everyone around this spring. If you like Metroidvania-style games or action RPGs, please look forward to it.

Here are some of the latest screenshots captured during the test play.
When I completed the game in one run at the end of last year, it took about 15.5 hours to clear, and it had a great sense of scale and a definite sense of satisfaction. I think there are two magic decks in the demo version, but I felt that there weren't enough during play, so I changed the specification to four, and the level of completion is increasing even more. Don't forget to prepare before setting out on your adventure this spring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/c68333fc6a7390199f6492acac4d923796a1e72b.jpg[/img]
↑ You can get hints from various people during your adventure. This is surprisingly important, and if you carelessly skip over it, you'll probably find yourself in a situation where you're wondering “what should I do here?” in the depths of the dungeon. Be sure to have a conversation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/2f10bf29356918ab87a28a2cf89f46c34fc3869c.jpg[/img]
↑ The fields in this game are really diverse. Please enjoy the artwork created with the persistence of the author, Turkey Games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/62b5f4df2a6ce3a71e12aee739b80e2fb4d74a2c.jpg[/img]
↑ There are multiple bosses on one field, and there are also bosses that are not directly related to the game progress that drop unique items... All the bosses are unique, and you can enjoy heated and fun battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/420f281edb2bcbb2fa318b8ab96be199348efb3d.jpg[/img]
↑ Although this is not a hidden element, there are various people living in the field. If you can find them, you may be able to buy valuable magic and equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/e993d2aee8b7a0436135dc0e89329e6de57e2aef.jpg[/img]
↑ A meaningful conversation. If you have a way to fly in the air, you might be able to go to more distant places?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/9439792fe6e03012dea7bf2f95972492bae03a7c.jpg[/img]
↑ The statue of the goddess, where you can save important points, and the peddler are both fully equipped!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946522/a8f9c1d567355188268aaff528886b15a6c517b2.jpg[/img]
↑ Enemies have magic that is weak against certain types of magic, and magic that is resistant to certain types of magic. The key to completing your adventure is to use the right magic at the right time. Don't forget to build up an effective magic deck when you have a collection of magic.


That's all for this time.
Please look forward to more information on 'Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures'.
Please add it to your wishlist and wait until the game is released!
